main:
Quality control for
CNC machined parts

Dimensional checks, material requirements and inspection records, agreed against your drawing.

Share critical dimensions, datums and functional requirements so we can agree the measurement methods, acceptance limits and required records before machining.

Discuss your inspection needs
CMM probe and fixture · LZZ inspection area
Inspection records and order acceptance

Define the information shown on dimensional and first-article reports, including the part number, drawing revision, specified features, datums, acceptance limits, measurement method and results.

Agree sampling, report format and any customer approval hold point before production.

Preview blank dimensional inspection format · no results
Documents to specify with your quotation

No customer report or measurement result is published on this site.

Dimensional & first-article reports
Reports identify the part number, drawing revision and part or batch reference. Specify whether acceptance dimensions apply before or after finishing; use the report fields above to agree the required results.
Material records
Specify the material grade, condition and required traceability. The quotation confirms which material documents will accompany your order.
Finishing documents
We arrange the treatment documentation required by your order, linked to the specified process and part or batch. State any special acceptance test or document requirement before production.
Surface & batch acceptance
Mark cosmetic faces, masked areas and edge conditions. Include sampling requirements and the approval process for any proposed deviation.

Ask LZZ to confirm which records can be supplied before machining. Your quotation will list the included documents and any extra cost.

Checks at each production stage
Drawing review

Agree critical features, datums and acceptance criteria.

First article

Check the initial part before the production run. Agree any customer approval hold point in advance.

In-process checks

Inspect agreed features during machining.

Final inspection

Verify the finished parts against the agreed order.

See the complete manufacturing process
Inspection equipment and methods

Choose the measurement method for the feature and its drawing limits. The equipment below covers dimensional checks; specify any additional tests with your quotation request.

Request the current calibration records during supplier review.

Coordinate measuring machine (CMM)
Positions and geometric features against drawing datums.
Height gauges
Heights and dimensions in the agreed setup.
Optical projectors
Profiles suited to optical measurement.
Other checks to specify
For threads, roughness, coating thickness or hardness, state the method and acceptance criteria on your drawing. Confirm checks and records with the quotation.
See machining and inspection equipment
Supplier qualification

LZZ is ISO 9001-certified. Request the current certificate for your supplier file and check the details listed here.

The company recognition documents are separate from the ISO certificate.

Request certificate & scope
Hangzhou Lizhizao Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.

When reviewing our ISO 9001 certificate, please check:

Named legal entity: Hangzhou Lizhizao Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
Certificate number, issuing certification body and verification method.
Issue and expiry dates, covered site and certified activities.
The current certificate copy and the inspection records required for your project.

Certificate number, issuer and current validity are available on request.
